speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe the exact location of your chest pain and what triggers it?

speaker: Patient
text: The pain is right in the center of my chest, feeling like a tight squeeze. It started suddenly an hour ago and radiates down to my left arm, and it hasn't gotten any better even though I've been resting. However, the laboratory information system is undergoing emergency maintenance. All blood tests are blocked. You must diagnose from the clinical presentation.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Myocardial Infarction (STEMI). Given the central squeezing pain radiating to the left arm that persists at rest, this is a medical emergency requiring immediate activation of the cardiac catheterization lab despite the lab system outage.
